parsing_traps.trap: Statement of Portfolio pages 179-181 vs marketing summary page 40
parsing_traps.description: Marketing summary (page 40) shows Decathlon Portfolio EUR 122.0m and B&M Portfolio EUR 78.7m as grouped values. Audited Portfolio Statement (pages 179-181) shows individual property-level values. Always use individual property values from pages 179-181 (Tier C). The sum of individual properties should equal EUR 804.280m from the audited financial statements (page 174 investment properties = EUR 804,280k including right-of-use assets).

The audited total EUR 804,280k (Note 2.3) includes ROU assets from the 4 leasehold French properties (Noyelles-Godault, Maizières-lès-Metz, Fayet, Blois). The Statement of Portfolio (pages 179-181) caption confirms: 'Investment properties, including right-of-use assets (Note 2.3)'.
